title: Defense Against Hexes
wikitext:
{{Quest infobox | name = Defense Against Hexes | campaign = Factions | region =Shing Jea Island | nationality = Canthan | type = Secondary | solo = y | given by = [[Instructor Ng]] | given at = [[Shing Jea Monastery]] | part of = [[Monk Insignia]]
[[Mesmer Insignia]] }} Advanced training for [[Cantha]]ns. Teaches how to remove [[hex]]es. == Quest information == === Requirements === {{Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | active = Any [[insignia quest]] }} * You must have [[Monk]] or [[Mesmer]] as your primary or secondary [[profession]]. === Objectives === * Speak with [[Lo Sha]]. * Speak with Lo Sha again to begin the test. * Defeat [[Su]] or survive for 2 minutes. * Speak with Lo Sha again. * See [[Instructor Ng]] for your reward. === Early benefits === Skills provided: * {{Mo}} {{skill icon|Remove Hex}} * {{Me}} {{skill icon|Shatter Hex}} === Reward === * 500 [[Experience]] * 50 [[Gold]] == Walkthrough == Using a hex removal skill will not ensure your survival; bring a healing skill as well. Alternatively, just hurt Su enough and you will complete the quest, regardless of how much time remains. == NPCs == * {{Me}} 10 [[Lo Sha]] * {{N}} 10 [[Su]] == Dialogue == === Initial dialogue === ;Instructor Ng ''One of the most important things you can learn in this dojo is how to defend yourself against the power of Hexes. Many foes use Hexes to limit your abilities, drain your Health and Energy, and so on. The strongest of us learn to successfully combat these techniques. Are you ready to enter my dojo and learn the art of Hex defense?'' :''By accepting this quest you will abandon other advanced training quests and put yourself into a separate training arena from the rest of your party, if applicable.'' {{Offer dialog | accept = I am prepared to meet this challenge. | decline = I'll return when I'm ready. | ask = Hexes are quite dangerous. You'd best complete this portion of your training if you want to prepare for the challenges ahead. }} === Intermediate dialogue === ;Lo Sha ''So you are ready to learn about Hex defense, are you? Well then, you will engage Instructor Su in combat. She is a master Necromancer with powerful Hexes in her arsenal. Defeat her and survive her Hexes, and you will have passed this test. Here are some skills that will aid you in this task. Good luck.'' ;Lo Sha ''Ready... begin!'' ;Lo Sha ''Congratulations, my friend. Su is a powerful Necromancer, but you held your own against her nicely. Return to Instructor Ng and he will reward you for your progress.'' === Reward dialogue === ;Instructor Ng ''Well done. You have completed your training in Defense Against Hexes. It is an important area of study, especially when facing Necromancers and Mesmers.'' == Notes == * Since the skills are given upon accepting this quest, you can actually learn all the skills. Simply take the quest, abandon it, switch secondary professions, then take the quest again. Repeat until your character learns all the skills. {{bug|Lo Sha claims the skills are provided by him, when they are provided by Instructer Ng.}} [[Category:Monk quests]] [[Category:Mesmer quests]] [[Category:Training]]
